author: John Hammond
description:
Attackers are increasingly abusing legitimate redirect services to make phishing campaigns harder to detect.

I walk through how trusted vendor domains, email security redirect services, Cloudflare Workers, and other infrastructure can be chained together before a victim reaches the final phishing page.

Watch the full video here: https://youtu.be/9b3kirR8s2U?si=unwsLMm2NhgqX1ge
title: Redirect Chain Abuse

author: John Hammond
description:
We've been sitting on this full story for five years. Silk Typhoon, sometimes called HAFNIUM, ran the 2021 Microsoft Exchange campaign that compromised 88,000 organizations.

We watched it unfold from inside the attacker's own infrastructure while the headlines first read "limited and targeted". On July 28, with Kyle Hanslovan and FBI Cyber Division Assistant Director Brett Leatherman, we're telling all the details -- from the cold calls and the war room decisions that we couldn't share until now.

Catch the show: https://jh.live/declassified
title: Microsoft Exchange Hacked, Five Years Later
